name: codemeld
description: Visual diff and merge editor for Visual Studio Code with connected change blocks and interactive merge controls.

codemeld.appearance.primary.markdownDescription: Primary CodeMeld accent color. Leave empty to inherit the active VS Code theme (`focusBorder`).

codemeld.appearance.add.markdownDescription: Color used for add actions. Leave empty to inherit the active VS Code theme (`gitDecoration.addedResourceForeground`).

codemeld.appearance.delete.markdownDescription: Color used for delete actions. Leave empty to inherit the active VS Code theme (`gitDecoration.deletedResourceForeground`).

codemeld.appearance.editorBackground.markdownDescription: Editor/list background color. Leave empty to inherit `editor.background` from the active VS Code theme.

codemeld.appearance.gutter.markdownDescription: Center gutter background color. Leave empty to inherit `editorWidget.background` from the active VS Code theme.

codemeld.appearance.highlight.markdownDescription: Intensity of CodeMeld diff highlighting, in percent.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run copy:monaco
